summary: 在句中作主语、宾语、表语、同位语的从句。三原则：引导词恰当 + 陈述句语序 + 时态呼应。
signals: whether 可放句首，if 不行

rules.title: 四类名词性从句
rules.detail: 主语从句（What he said is true.）、宾语从句（I know that he is honest.）、表语从句（The problem is that we lack money.）、同位语从句（The news that we won made us excited. 说明 news 的内容）。

examples.en: What surprised me most was his attitude.
examples.zh: 最让我惊讶的是他的态度。

examples.en: The fact that light travels faster than sound is known to us.
examples.zh: 光比声音传播得快，这个事实我们都知道。

rules.title: that 与 what 的区别
rules.detail: what 在从句中充当成分（主语/宾语），含义是「……的东西」；that 不充当任何成分，无实义，宾语从句中可省略（其他从句不可省）。

examples.en: I can't understand what he is talking about.（about 的宾语）
The reason is that he missed the bus.
examples.zh: 原因是他错过了公交车。

rules.title: it 作形式主语与 whether/if 区别
rules.detail: 主语从句太长时用 it 作形式主语：It is said that...；whether 可引导主语从句（放句首），if 不行；介词后用 whether；whether...or not 搭配。

examples.en: It is certain that hard work leads to success.
Whether he will attend the meeting is unknown.
examples.zh: 他是否参加会议还不得而知。

pitfalls: what/that 混用：❌ The news that he told me is true（told 缺宾语 → what）→ ✓ The news that he won is true（不缺成分用 that）
从句用疑问语序：❌ The question is where will we go. → ✓ ...where we will go.
主语从句误用 if：❌ If he will come is unknown. → ✓ Whether he will come is unknown.

questions.stem: ___ we need most is more time and practice.
questions.explain: 从句中 need 缺宾语，用 what（= the thing that）。

questions.stem: The news ___ our team won the match spread quickly.
questions.explain: 同位语从句解释 news 的内容，从句成分完整，用 that。

questions.stem: ___ the meeting will be held hasn't been decided yet.
questions.explain: 主语从句放句首表「是否」只能用 whether。

questions.stem: The reason ___ he was late was ___ he missed the early bus.
questions.explain: The reason why...is that... 固定句型：表语从句用 that 不用 because。

questions.stem: It is clear ___ he is the right person for the job.
questions.explain: It 作形式主语，真正主语从句成分完整，用 that。

questions.stem: I have no idea ___ ___ the meeting will begin. (two words: 什么时候)
questions.explain: 同位语从句保留疑问词 when/what time，但用陈述语序：when the meeting will begin。

questions.stem: The problem is if we can finish the work on time.
questions.explain: 表语从句表「是否」用 whether，不用 if。

questions.stem: 他是否会对这个决定感到后悔还是个问题。（翻译整句）
answer: whether he will regret the decision is still a question.
it is still a question whether he will regret the decision.
questions.explain: whether 引导主语从句；也可用 it 作形式主语。

questions.stem: 我们要去哪里度假取决于天气。（翻译整句）
answer: where we will spend our holiday depends on the weather.
where we will go for the holiday depends on the weather.
questions.explain: where 引导主语从句，陈述语序；depend on 取决于。
